decision_threshold_note: Deployment uses 0.35 (lowered from the calibrated 0.5) to catch BEC and brand-impersonation phishing in the borderline 0.35-0.50 zone; complemented by a sender-reputation allowlist override and a hard-signal escalation rule in detector.py.
note: TF-IDF fit on real email bodies (5000 max features, 1-2 ngrams), calibrated via CalibratedClassifierCV (sigmoid, cv=5)
